200.description: One page of the stops of the wave.

stopKey.description: Opaque keyed hash of the normalized address, from shipping-and-tracking; `pkg:<trackingNumber>` when no label data was received.

destinationPostalPrefix.description: Present when the label data carried it.

400.description: The request is malformed at the HTTP level. Problem types `idempotency-key-required` (no Idempotency-Key header), `idempotency-key-invalid` (not 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters), `invalid-limit`, `invalid-cursor`, `unknown-query-parameter`. `invalid-limit` is a limit outside 1 to 500, empty or repeated; `invalid-cursor` a cursor that is not a page token or is repeated.

title.example: The wave has no stop capacity left

404.description: The wave, route, partner or (for an attempt) the package on the route does not exist, or the path matches no route or holds a NUL character. Problem types `not-found`, `package-not-on-route`, `resource-not-found`.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, only when the answer is a replay of the stored first answer.

title.example: The wave has no stop capacity left

422.description: Validation failed. Problem types: `validation-failed` (body that is not valid JSON for the operation, with an unknown field, empty, with trailing data or over 64 KiB; a NUL character in the query or body; a missing or malformed query filter; a value-object rule), `invalid-wave-times` (ErrInvalidWaveTimes), `invalid-van-capacity` (ErrInvalidVanCapacity), `unknown-station` (ErrUnknownStation).

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, only when the answer is a replay of the stored first answer.

title.example: The wave has no stop capacity left

500.description: Unexpected failure: problem type `internal-error`, detail "an unexpected error occurred". Never stored for idempotent replay.

title.example: The wave has no stop capacity left
